subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the booking-recovery program for {Brand}, building on my earlier emails about abandoned-checkout and lapsed bookers. If incremental, net-of-cancellation bookings are on your roadmap this season, I can share the route-level recovery breakdown and a short holdout read this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way, you have the context for whenever it becomes useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN travel_and_booking retargeting: references original and earlier stages; direct close with easy out (releases prospect if timing is wrong); no figure; zero question marks; soft CTA; no sign-off; native US English; no X-not-Y.
